reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:263-270, .small-action uses @include flexbox() while its direct flex-item child .topic-avatar (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/small-action.hbs:1) still sets float: left, which is ignored on flex items. Note that .avatar (topic-post.scss:298) and button (topic-post.scss:309) are nested inside the non-flex block container .small-action-desc (small-action.hbs:2-11), so their float declarations remain active rather than dead.
